item.title: Sun in Leo: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Sun in Leo means the Sun was in Leo when you were born. In astrology the Sun stands for your core self; Leo is a fire sign ruled by the Sun, warm and proud. You were made to be seen, and to make others feel seen. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Sun in Cancer: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Sun in Cancer means the Sun was in Cancer when you were born. In astrology the Sun stands for your core self; Cancer is a water sign ruled by the Moon, tender and protective. You lead with care, and it makes you stronger than you look. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Sun in Gemini: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Sun in Gemini means the Sun was in Gemini when you were born. In astrology the Sun stands for your core self; Gemini is an air sign ruled by Mercury, curious and quick. Your curiosity is the engine; conversation is the fuel. Read more at astralroots.app
